## What is OwlEar?
OwlEar is a free Android app that warns you about trackers that might be following you, hidden Bluetooth devices nearby, and license-plate cameras.

No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

## What's new
- **A clearer radar.** Each kind of device has its own icon, with a rough distance. Tap any icon to see its details, and use the buttons across the top to hide the kinds you don't care about.
- **Find it.** Open any device and tap **Find it** to walk toward it. A big meter tells you if you're getting warmer or colder, with an optional beep or silent buzz that speeds up as you get closer.
- **Check for updates.** A button in Settings opens this page so you can see if there's a newer version.
- Small fixes.

## How to install
1. On your Android phone, scroll down to **Assets** below and tap the file that ends in **.apk**.
2. When the download finishes, open it.
3. If your phone asks, allow your browser to install apps. This is normal for apps from outside the Play Store.
4. Tap **Install**.

## Updating
Already have OwlEar? Just install the new version the same way. It updates over the old one, and your settings stay.

**Tip:** if you want to hear about new versions automatically, install the free app [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium) and add `github.com/OwlEar/owlear`. It will tell you when there's an update and install it for you.

OwlEar is for Android only right now.
